allowPty.description: Allow PTY allocation for sandboxed processes

allowedDomains.description: Domains allowed for network access (supports wildcards)

deniedDomains.description: Domains denied for network access (takes precedence over allowedDomains)

allowUnixSockets.description: Unix socket paths to allow (macOS: path allowlist; Linux: ignored, uses seccomp)

allowAllUnixSockets.description: Allow all Unix sockets (macOS: bypass; Linux: disable seccomp blocking)

deniedDomainReasons.description: Map from deniedDomains entries to model-facing reason strings

allowRead.description: Paths to re-allow read access within denied regions

denyWrite.description: Paths to deny write access within allowed paths

ignoreViolations.description: Map command patterns to arrays of paths where violations should be ignored

allowAppleEvents.description: Allow Apple Events and Launch Services from macOS sandbox (security warning: enables code execution outside sandbox)

enableWeakerNestedSandbox.description: Enable weaker sandbox mode for Docker environments without privileged namespaces

enableWeakerNetworkIsolation.description: Allow access to com.apple.trustd.agent for Go TLS verification (security warning: potential data exfiltration vector)

credentials.description: Credential masking configuration for sensitive data

files.description: Files to mask (whole-file or structured regex patterns)

allowClearTextInNonTls.description: Allow injecting real credentials into non-TLS connections (dangerous)

mandatoryDenySearchDepth.description: Linux: ripgrep search depth for mandatory deny paths (1-10, default 3)

tlsTerminate.description: TLS termination config for MITM proxy (experimental)

excludeDomains.description: Domain patterns to exclude from TLS termination

extraCaCertPaths.description: Paths to PEM CA certificate files to append to trust bundle

proxyPortRange.description: Port range [low, high] for JS proxies (must match windows-install --proxy-port-range)

sublayerGuid.description: WFP sublayer GUID under which filters were installed

sandboxUser.description: Name of the dedicated Windows sandbox user account (default: srt-sandbox)

path.description: Path to srt-win binary (omit to use bundled vendor copy)
